title: LedgerLine
description: One line of the ledger: an event and its place in the chain. The event is checked against the event schema on its own.

prev.description: SHA-256, in hex, of the bytes of the line before as they stand in the file, without its line break. Null on the first line.

hash.description: SHA-256, in hex, of the event in its fixed form: the JSON Canonicalization Scheme, RFC 8785, in UTF-8.

event.description: The event, in its fixed form.
